_comment: Ordered store-screenshot slots. Each slot has a stable id and a localized caption per Play language folder. Raw shots are captured per locale into temp/play-shots/<locale>/<id>.png (compose falls back to temp/play-shots/<id>.png when a locale has no own shot). Composed output lands in play/listing/<locale>/images/phoneScreenshots/<NN>.png in slot order. Captions are short marketing lines (<=2 lines via \n). Play caps phone screenshots at 8 slots.
